description: Synchronous work that holds the single JavaScript thread. Until it ends, no request, timer or I/O callback runs.
Pausing a long job with `await setImmediate()` so pending I/O callbacks run before the next chunk. Microtasks (`await Promise.resolve()`) do not yield.
How late a timer fires compared to its schedule. A direct measure of how long the loop was blocked.
Marks a timer as not keeping the process alive. Monitoring timers should be unref'd so they never block shutdown.
`perf_hooks` histogram of loop delay with percentiles (p50, p99): the production way to measure lag.
Rejecting new work with `503` and `Retry-After` while the process is overloaded, so the backlog drains instead of everything timing out.
